traps: Vite is configured under the vite key of astro.config.ts but is not a dependency: it is Astro's internal bundler
@astrojs/mdx, @astrojs/sitemap and @astrojs/rss are Astro integrations, not frameworks of their own
Giscus, GitHub Pages and other services appear only in the blog posts under src/content/posts, which are content, not configuration
the Dockerfile serves the static build with nginx: it is the app's own container, not a service
Pagefind builds a static search index at build time: it is a tool, not a search service
only frameworks and services are measured; the other facets are in unknown
